description: Source code for a PyTorch distributed benchmarking suite that measures training iteration times across different model architectures and process counts, including setup, benchmarking, and result reporting.

classes.name: Benchmark
classes.description: Base class for benchmarking models with methods to create models and generate inputs/targets.

classes.name: TorchvisionBenchmark
classes.description: Subclass of Benchmark for torchvision models, providing model creation and input generation.

methods.name: allgather_object
methods.description: Gathers an object from all processes in the distributed group.

methods.name: allgather_run
methods.description: Runs a shell command and gathers its output across processes.

methods.name: allequal
methods.description: Checks if all elements in an iterator are equal.

methods.name: benchmark_process_group
methods.description: Runs a benchmark on a process group, measuring iteration times.

methods.name: run_benchmark
methods.description: Runs benchmarks across different process ranks and aggregates results.

methods.name: sweep
methods.description: Performs a series of benchmarks with different configurations and reports results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to initialize benchmarking, parse arguments, and execute benchmarks.
